articles.title: Celina Jaitly Files Domestic Violence FIR Against Husband Peter
articles.summary: Mumbai Police have officially registered an FIR against Peter Haag, husband of Bollywood actress Celina Jaitly, following serious allegations of domestic violence. This legal action underscores the swift response of law enforcement to grave societal issues. Aspirants should be aware of such national developments and the legal frameworks involved in addressing complaints of this nature.

articles.title: Diablo 4's Next Patch Fixes Massive Amounts of Bugs in Another Win for Lord of Hatred
articles.summary: The article details recent game updates focusing on 'Talisman' elements, specifically enhancing 'Set Charms'. These in-game items now feature unique drop sounds for better audibility and distinct minimap icons for improved visibility. Such changes aim to make these particular charms easier for players to notice and locate within the game environment, thereby enhancing user experience and interaction with game mechanics.

articles.title: Kremlin tells Australian embassy in Kyiv to evacuate amid parade tensions
articles.summary: The Australian embassy in Ukraine is on high alert, evacuating staff from Kyiv following a Kremlin warning of potential "massive missile strikes" this weekend. This action mirrors caution taken by several other diplomatic missions in the capital. The situation underscores the continued heightened risk to international presence and civilian areas amidst the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: 2026 NBA Draft Lottery: Each team's odds of landing the first overall pick
articles.summary: The 2026 NBA Draft Lottery, scheduled for Sunday, is anticipated to be one of the most significant in league history. This is primarily due to imminent lottery reforms expected to drastically alter team building strategies and player allocation. This pivotal event could reshape the competitive landscape, making it a landmark moment in NBA history as teams vie for top draft picks.
